lens: Editorial and brand craft — first encounter (simulated AI lens)
reason: The public composition is disciplined and recognizably Precision Instrument: strong sans headlines, restrained mono metadata, useful hairlines, readable prose and consistent navy/paper/orange roles. Desktop and mobile captures preserve hierarchy and give both audiences a clear next action. The captioned member photograph is credible culture imagery. However, the central client proposition still lacks an inspectable example of MECG’s actual work. Named organizations and a polished process illustration establish association and intent, rather than demonstrate the quality of research or recommendations. That is a material editorial shortfall against a world-class claim for a consulting site. I traced the real client inquiry implementation from homepage CTA through engagement terms, contact guidance, form feedback and API handler; the supplied passing journey test intercepts delivery. This is source/capture assessment by an AI panel seat, not observed user success. Release readiness remains unproven without hosted integration evidence.

findings.evidence: The captured “Real organizations. Specific questions.” section renders the generic fallback at home/page.tsx:79-80 and “Case studies pending client approval,” followed by organization/sector rows. PUBLIC_PROJECTS is empty. The only homepage photograph at lines 135-136 is explicitly a PwC member visit. DESIGN.md §7 confirms zero project artifacts. The work page likewise omits Selected work when publicProjects is empty (lines 56-63).
findings.userImpact: A prospective client can understand the service and its terms but cannot inspect a real question, method, deliverable or bounded result before choosing to inquire. The precision of the presentation currently exceeds the specificity of its proof.
findings.suggestedFix: Obtain client and MECG approval for at least one concrete engagement: decision question, methods, redacted deliverable image and factual handoff or result with limits. Feature that evidence ahead of the general capabilities/process material and retain the culture photograph in its people context. Keep the honest pending status until approval; do not fabricate outcomes.
